content.text:
Hidradenitis suppurativa codelist (CPRD Read codes):

| Read code | Term | Include |
|---|---|---|
| M25y1-1 | Hidradenitis suppurativa | Yes |
| M25y1 | Hidradenitis | Yes |

I searched for "hidradenitis", "acne inversa", "Verneuil" and "apocrine", and I browsed the M25y code family. I excluded these codes:
- Other sweat gland disorders, such as Fox-Fordyce disease, chromhidrosis, bromhidrosis and acne keloid.
- The non-specific codes "Apocrine sweat disorder, unspecified" (M25yX) and "Disorder of apocrine gland" (Myu6J).
- The apocrine neoplasm codes.

M25y1 ("Hidradenitis") is the parent of the suppurativa term. I included it because in practice it almost always refers to hidradenitis suppurativa.
